subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should `captionedFinalText` become a supported public channel plugin capability for caption-aware final-mode TTS delivery?
rationale: The bug is established, but the proposed solution expands the plugin contract and makes core suppression behavior depend on third-party channel declarations that can cause message loss when implemented incorrectly.

options.title: Accept the capability contract
options.body: Repair the missing observer, require compatibility tests and exact-head Telegram proof, then support `captionedFinalText` as the generic plugin seam.

options.title: Keep the behavior internal
options.body: Implement the Telegram repair through an existing internal channel boundary and defer a public plugin capability until additional channels require it.

options.title: Decline bundled-caption behavior
options.body: Do not land this direction and retain separate text-plus-audio delivery until the product behavior and compatibility policy are reconsidered.

recommendation.title: Accept the capability contract
recommendation.body: Repair the missing observer, require compatibility tests and exact-head Telegram proof, then support `captionedFinalText` as the generic plugin seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this person to the shared dispatch, channel-capability, and Telegram/plugin boundaries requiring the product/API choice.
